title: Building Surge AI to $1 Billion with Edwin Chen
description:
Edwin Chen, Founder & CEO of Surge AI, joins SPC Partner Evan Tana to discuss building a bootstrapped AI unicorn. Surge AI provides the high-quality human feedback (RLHF) that powers the world's most advanced Large Language Models. 

In this interview, Edwin breaks down why data quality is the biggest bottleneck for AGI, why he chose to bootstrap instead of raising VC funding, and the difference between "textbook smart" and "street smart" AI models.
